purpose: Separate native collocated grid/barrier/bath semantics from an explicitly conservative positive face operator
source_scope: Actual authenticated AST Simulator initDenv/update_ecm, full zero-membrane/GJ molecule_mover branch, bath initialization/firing, FD/Nernst/gaussian helpers and wound coefficient statements; normalized explicit geometry/fields, no cut/full solver

native_semantics.barriers: D_free outside; adherens overwrite in cluster; tight*relative overwrite three boundary sets; sodium/max normalization; duplicated target occurrences retained; molecule target factor applied once per duplicate advanced-assignment location
native_semantics.gradient: Central interior, positive one-sided boundary gradients; divergence diff reverses boundary signs; composed stencil spans two sites
native_semantics.boundary: Perimeter site values clamped before transport; resulting output is not reset; native stage amount accounting is not face conservation
native_semantics.molecule: Sodium-normalized weight plus molecule TJ factor; ignores ion TJ_modulator; extra mobility/flow not blocked by zero diffusion; all-zero small bath <=1e-15 skips
native_semantics.smoothing: Neighbor averaging only when sharpness<1, preserves current boundary values but not total amount
native_semantics.bath: K then Cl then Na overwrite baselines/counterions; overlapping events need not be charge neutral; non-ECM legacy fields differ and may be absent
native_semantics.clipping: Ionic update leaves negative outputs; molecule mover raises; explicit no_negs diagnostic clips with measured amount change and is not invoked by update_ecm

conservative_law.name: Distinct Bernoulli-fitted face flux, harmonic D and explicit scalar drift/advection; zero D becomes upwind
conservative_law.geometry: Complete explicit nearest-neighbor/internal face owners, physical perimeter faces, corner two ports; uniform square grid and height give volumes/areas; boundary distance half spacing
conservative_law.flux: J = D/l * [cL B(-Pe)-cR B(Pe)], Pe=w*l/D, w=(D*z*q/kBT+mu)*E_normal+u_normal; B=x/expm1(x)
conservative_law.boundary: Explicit sealed/fixed face bath masks; no site clamping; per-face signed bath amount ledger
conservative_law.domain: Finite nonnegative concentrations/D/bath, positive thermal constants/dt, |Pe|<=500, outgoing Euler Courant<=1, no floors/clipping; species and global charge budgets include external bath
conservative_law.scope: Prescribed E/flow; no field solve or native discretization equivalence

units.source_F: 96485 C/mol; separate rounded constant, no silent SI replacement

reference: Independent stdlib ordered stencil/region/Gaussian/pulse loops and 80-digit Decimal face flux/budgets; no production/NumPy/JAX imports
scope_limits: Source stage changes are not inferred physical boundary fluxes
No cut execution/evolving geometry or physical remap
No whole-tissue, Poisson/current closure, thermodynamic/ATP or shared checkpoint claim
Frozen geometry/common numerical primitives read only; source defects and unsupported clipping remain preserved
